required_fixes: R1 — crates/desktop-core/src/authority/inbox_domain.rs:379, crates/desktop-core/src/authority.rs:3755 and :3837: guarded resolutions irreversibly end/discard the conversation before the tenant change is saved. If save_with returns a definite StoreError, it restores only Data; the source tenant stays active, but the conversation is stopped, the refusal reference is cleared, and Discard's history tombstone remains. The deletion job has already been drained into effects, which AuthorityHandle::dispatch clears on error at authority.rs:3484. Consequently, a refused switch can terminate the pending conversation while retaining its protected transcript without a settled discard-failure notice; retrying the old resolution is stale. Both SelectTenant and CompleteTenantSetup have this ordering. Make persistence failure preserve the unresolved conversation and guard before destructive effects occur. Acceptance: production-interface fault-injection regressions for Archive and Discard through both paths must force a save failure after obtaining the refusal binding, verify the source tenant, pending decision, conversation and protected transcript remain unchanged, then restore storage and demonstrate one successful resolution with the intended history outcome.
evidence_gaps: E1 — crates/desktop-core/tests/harness_tools/main.rs covers stale resolutions, successful guarded switching/setup completion and history-removal failures, but does not inject failure of the tenant-state save during resolution. The retained passing suites and native runs therefore do not establish R1's refusal/recovery behavior. Add and retain the production-interface regressions specified in R1.
